label: Потом
description: A 10-sentence usage card for потом (then; afterwards; later).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Sequencing with сначала. Paired with 'сначала' the adverb 'потом' marks the second step in a sequence, what happens afterwards. It orders two future actions in time.
Strategic focus: Vague later. Here 'потом' means later, at some unspecified future moment. Placed at the end it postpones the call without naming a time.
Strategic focus: Deferring a topic. 'Потом' pushes the conversation to a later point, a common way to set something aside. It implies now is not the right moment.
Strategic focus: Then in a narrative question. In a story 'потом' asks what happened next, advancing the sequence of events. It invites the speaker to continue the tale.

missions.phrase: Мы пообедали, а потом пошли в кино.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Then in the past. With past verbs 'а потом' chains a second completed action after the first. It is the everyday connector for telling what came afterwards.
Strategic focus: Postponed decision. 'Потом' defers the thinking to a later time, fronting the topic for emphasis. It signals the matter is not urgent right now.
Strategic focus: Order in commands. With imperatives 'а потом' sets the required order, homework first and play afterwards. It enforces a sequence between two instructions.
Strategic focus: A warning about delay. Fronted 'потом' points to a later moment that will be too late, urging action now. It frames the future as a closing window.
Strategic focus: Proverbial sequencing. In this aphoristic command 'потом' orders speaking after thinking. The сначала-потом frame gives the advice its rhythmic, instructive feel.
Strategic focus: A promise for later. With a perfective future 'потом' promises a full explanation at a later time. It reassures while still postponing the details.
